ajacca.p: [Na+jacca] (ti) CL=10 to be of low-inferior caste. A person of low caste. See also Ittarajacca-
pn: Ajacca. One of the disciples mentioned in the Sīlavīmaṁsana Jātaka as having tried to win their teacher’s daughter and failed. Ja.iii.19.
a: အမျိုးဇာတ်-သိမ်ငယ်-နိမ့်ကျ-သော၊ သူ။ ဣတ္တရဇစ္စ-လည်းကြည့်။

DOP: ajacca mfn. [a 3 + jacca], of low birth ; Ja VI 100, 9* (jātimantaṃ ~aṃ ca ahaṃ ujjugataṃ naraṃ ativelaṃ namassissaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee jātivantaṃ ~aṃ; 102, 7´ : ujjugataṃ ekaṃ pi naraṃ hīnajacco vā hotu jātisampanno vā … namassissan ti); — ajacco in Ee at Ja III 19, 22* is prob. wr for sujacco ( Be, Ce, Se so ).
CPD: a-jacca , mfn., of low birth, Ja Vl 100, 9 * (= hīna- jacca, Ct.; opp. jātiva(t), which is w. r. for jātima(t)); Ja lll 19, 22 * ( used as a Npr., cf. Ct. ).
